chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Hammad ibn 'Isa, and Safwan, and Fadalah, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who entered into ihram for the 'umrah and forgot to shorten his hair until he entered into the hajj. He said: He should seek Allah’s forgiveness, and there is nothing upon him, and his 'umrah is complete.

key_terms.أَهَلَّ: entered into the state of ihram and began the rite
key_terms.وَتَمَّتْ عُمْرَتُهُ: his 'umrah is considered complete and valid
key_terms.وَلَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: there is no penalty or liability upon him
key_terms.يُقَصِّرَ: to shorten the hair as the required rite of taqsir

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets taqsir after 'umrah until entering hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgets taqsir after entering 'umrah and only remembers after beginning hajj. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام rules that he should seek forgiveness, bears no liability, and his 'umrah remains valid.
